detailed_description:
The target video is a living painterly illustration in <Subject 1>: brushstroke texture stays visible as everything moves, motion is slow, gentle and dreamlike.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The river of stars flows slowly away from the camera like calm glowing water, and round lily pads and white water lilies drift along its current, soft rings of light spreading where they float. The camera glides forward along the river at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move, lowering gently as it travels until it skims just above the glowing current. The nearest lily pads grow large and pass close on both sides of the frame. Far ahead, where the river curves away, the bright golden point on the horizon becomes a small round planet glowing softly. The nebula above drifts slowly. The camera is still gliding forward as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
